name: Spicy Mexican-Style Pasta Salad with Shrimp, Corn, Peppers & Cilantro (Prep-Ahead)

ingredients.name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes 4 medium storage containers.

Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds; cook until just tender, about 6 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 lime
½ jalapeño pepper
1 English cucumber
½ small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Juice lime into a medium bowl. Add yogurt, mayo, and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup plain Greek yogurt
3 tbsp mayonnaise
2 tsp chili powder
½ tsp oregano, dried
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl with the dressing.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level, then small dice. Add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Trim and small dice cucumber. Add to the bowl and set aside.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl and set aside.
If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.)
instructions.secondary_message: 454 g raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: When the pasta is just tender, add shrimp to the pot, stir, and continue to cook until pasta is desired doneness and shrimp are cooked through, 1-2 minutes more. Drain in a colander and rinse under cold water to cool.
Meanwhile, rinse corn under hot water (from the tap). Add to the bowl, along with Parmesan.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cups frozen corn
⅓ cup Parmesan cheese, shredded

instructions.primary_message: When the pasta and shrimp are cool, add to the bowl and stir to combine the pasta salad.
Divide pasta salad between the storage containers, cover, and refrigerate until ready to eat. Enjoy!
